verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's search/marketplace page and API let anyone see live per-GPU-hour prices without contacting sales (docs-41, docs-50, docs-26/33), and the CLI/API make prices programmatically queryable (docs-20, docs-2). However, a hands-on community report explicitly complains that finding even an approximate price takes many clicks, suggesting no simple static per-GPU-type pricing page exists (vast-ai-comm-3), and pricing is dynamic/bid-based rather than a fixed published rate table. missing for 10: a dedicated static pricing page listing one price per GPU type, and corroboration that price discovery is quick/frictionless.
